answer: Persistent Work Ledger. Each identity must complete a randomized, multi-step task chain whose intermediate outputs are hashed and chained (a pigment unique to that run), so partial work cannot be reused across clones. A cloned identity inherits no prior hashes, forcing it to redo the full canyon of prior steps at full compute cost. Rewards unlock only at chain completion, and the marginal clone's expected payout falls below its replication cost. Falcon audits sample chains to verify hash continuity.
